name: Brute Force: Alien Onslaught

features.name: Low-symbol upgrade
features.description: Wilds turn low symbols on their reel into mid symbols.

features.name: REDemption and BLU Genesis Spins
features.description: Bonus routes decided by scatter colour.

review:
A 6x5 sci-fi sequel with four kinds of stacked xNudge wilds – most reveal a random multiplier at the bottom when they nudge into view, and ordinary wilds upgrade every low symbol on their reel.

REDemption and Super REDemption Spins depend on how many red scatters trigger them, while BLU Genesis Spins are a separate route, and some wilds turn sticky in the bonuses. Insane volatility with an 80,000x max – one of the biggest in Nolimit's catalogue.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
